task.title: Step 04b: TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR validates the test spec (HARD GATE)
task.description: Validate the test spec at tests/specs/iss-0706-gbl116-bench-pre-flight.md and the corresponding Zig test source at tests/integration/iss0706_gbl116_bench_preflight_test.zig. Check: (1) every MUST AC has a concrete Zig test reference; (2) no test coverage is deferred (no 'TODO: implement test for X' placeholders); (3) fixtures are isolated (each test sets up and tears down its own DB state); (4) tests are self-sufficient (no shared mutable state across tests); (5) pipeline chain is wired (the spec lists zig build → zig build test → zig build test-integration-iss0706 → zig build bench smoke); (6) the 10 MUST-NOT ACs are covered (negative tests exist where appropriate). This is a HARD GATE — PASS allows Step 05 TEST-RUNNER to proceed; FAIL routes back to Step 04 for rework.

checklist_results.justification: 21 concrete Zig test references in spec point to file path + line number; each MUST AC (1-10) and MUST-NOT AC (1-10) has at least one reference in the §Regression coverage table. Spot-verified: lines 165, 185, 226, 85, 127, 247, 281 all land on the actual test blocks in the Zig source.

No TODO/FIXME/covered-by-future-test placeholders. The 2 hits for deferred/phase 2 are inside the explicit coverage-completeness statement (line 355): No AC is labelled deferred, future, or phase 2. These are negations, not placeholders.

Live-DB tests (AC-5.1.3 at line 85, AC-5.1.6 at line 127) each create their own Pool via makePool() and release it in defer. The NULL/NOW restore UPDATEs use defer to clean up. Source-assertion tests (165, 185, 226, 247, 281) read files via std.Io.Dir.cwd().readFileAlloc with 8MB cap and free in defer - no state mutation.

Each of the 7 test blocks is order-independent. Each live-DB test acquires its own Pool, runs its query, and releases. No test depends on the side-effect of another. SkipZigTest pattern on BPM_TEST_DB_URL-missing tests is per-test, not shared.

Spec Pipeline chain section lists the four steps in order: zig build -> zig build test -> zig build test-integration-iss0706 -> zig build bench. Each step role documented (typecheck/lint, source-assertion cases, live-DB cases, smoke). Suite already registered as test-integration-iss0706 by Step 03.

All 10 MUST-NOT ACs appear in the Regression coverage table. MUST-NOT-1 has TC-07 source-assertion at line 281 with 5 invariants. MUST-NOT-4 verified by TC-03 inspecting SELECT count(*) text. MUST-NOT-7/9/10 verified by TC-02 at line 185.

Same format as other tests/specs/*.md: Test Spec heading; Requirement/Priority/Test layer metadata; Scope prose; Test cases with TC-<ID>-NN Given/When/Then; Pipeline chain; Failure modes; Manual checks; Isolation and security contract; Regression coverage table; Wiring; Requirement traceability.
Coverage table covers exactly the 20 ACs (MUST-1..10, MUST-NOT-1..10) declared in design §6.1 and §6.2. No additional ACs.
